title: Workbench For Real Repos
motto: Eleven lessons of surfaces are worth nothing if they do not survive contact with a real codebase. This lesson runs the same task twice on a small sample app: prompt-only versus workbench-guided. The numbers do the arguing.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Eleven lessons of surfaces are worth nothing if they do not survive contact with a real codebase. This lesson runs the same task twice on a small sample app: prompt-only versus workbench-guided. The numbers do the arguing.

steps.title: The problem
cards: A demo on a toy task convinces no one. The case for the workbench is made when a real-feeling task on a real-feeling repo lands in production with fewer failures, fewer reverts, and a packet the next session can use.
This lesson ships that real-feeling repo and runs the same task through both pipelines. The result is a before/after report you can hand to a skeptic.
